hetzner401.help:
The Hetzner Cloud API refused the request:
• 401 unauthorized — the token is wrong, or it was revoked or rotated: use a current one.
• 403 forbidden — the token lacks Read & Write (it is Read-only), or the project forbids the call, for example at one of its limits.
• 429 rate limit — too many requests: wait, then try again.
• 5xx — an outage at the provider; check https://status.hetzner.com/.
hetzner401.message: hetzner-cloud GET /v1/locations failed (status 401): unauthorized: unable to authenticate

hetzner403.message: hetzner-cloud GET /v1/locations failed (status 403): forbidden: insufficient permissions

tokenRejected.help: The provider did not accept this token (401 unauthorized): it was mistyped, or it was revoked or rotated, or its project was deleted. A token is shown only once, when it is created: paste it again from where you saved it, or create a new one with Read & Write permission in the Hetzner Console (open the project, then Security → API tokens).
